messages:
emma: Hey team — quick question: my dental & vision coverage shows as "Pending" in the portal. I had a cleaning yesterday and want to submit for reimbursement. Do benefits start on hire date or the 1st of the next month? cc @lisa :wave:
benefits-bot: Hi Emma! Your benefits enrollment was received. Carrier effective date: 2026-04-01 (enrolled during new-hire window). To submit a reimbursement, upload receipts to Expensify within 90 days and tag `healthcare-reimbursements`. Docs: https://redwood.intranet/benefits/enroll :link:
lisa: Confirming — the carrier effective date is 2026-04-01. Since your service date 2026-03-22 is before that, it’s technically not covered, but we can try retro reimbursement if the carrier allows it. Please file the expense and include EOB or itemized receipt, provider name, and date of service. If you want us to escalate, reply here and I’ll route to benefits admin. :white_check_mark:
emma: Thanks — what's the exact category and do I mark it as pre-tax? Also, is there any form I need to sign for retro reimbursements?
raj: Payroll note: If the expense qualifies as a medical expense (with EOB/receipt) and is processed through our benefits admin, reimbursement is typically non-taxable. In Expensify pick category `healthcare-reimbursements` and add the claim type "benefits reimbursement." No extra payroll form needed unless there's taxable compensation involved.
sam: If you need fast processing, file a People Ops ticket with subject "urgent benefits reimbursement" and attach the receipt. We can fast-track emergency cases (usually 3-5 business days) :thumbsup:
emma: Uploading now. Quick Q — do I need to redact card numbers on the receipt?
lisa: Yes please redact full card numbers for privacy, but keep last 4 digits if the provider receipt shows them. Also include provider name and diagnosis/procedure line if present.

Example expense note (paste into Expensify description):
```
Provider: BrightSmile Dental
Date of service: 2026-03-22
Service: Routine cleaning
Amount: $85.00
Category: healthcare-reimbursements
Attachments: itemized receipt + EOB
Notes: New-hire retro request, coverage effective 2026-04-01. Please escalate to benefits admin if carrier denial needed for appeal.
```

emma: Done — submitted the claim and attached the EOB. Ticket #PO-3921 created. Thanks everyone! :pray:
lisa: Got it, I see the ticket. I’ll ping benefits admin and update you in this thread when I hear back (should be within 2-4 business days).
raj: Once processed, payroll will issue reimbursement as a separate non-payroll payment. Expect it in the next vendor run after approval.
emma: Awesome — appreciate the quick help! :smile:
